records.text: DuPont completed what was then the largest corporate merger in history with Conoco in 1983
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: In 1983, DuPont completes the largest merger in corporate history with Conoco Oil, and they're able to do this thanks to Reagan and George Bush being in office, deregulating things, making it easier for private corporations to go in and do bigger deals.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. A contemporaneous federal court opinion describes the DuPont-Conoco merger as occurring in summer 1981 and as the largest merger to that date, directly contradicting the claimed 1983 date.

sources.title: Conoco Inc. v. United States
sources.relevance: Contemporaneous federal opinion dates the DuPont-Conoco merger to summer 1981.
